subhead: A record of my public speaking engagements: panels, emceeing, pitches and workshops. For more detail on any of them, get in touch.

items.title: JA Money Sense Workshop
items.host: JA Hong Kong · Creative Secondary School
items.summary: Spoke on two panels about teenage financial literacy, covering needs vs wants, financial resilience and smart online shopping, in English.

items.title: HKU × Zester Common Core Staff Workshop
items.summary: Planned and ran a 90-minute interactive workshop for HKU Common Core teaching staff, who played the Zester card game and explored how gamified SDG learning applies to their teaching.

items.title: HKSTP Townhall: Summer Intern Appreciation & Sharing Session
items.host: Hong Kong Science and Technology Parks Corporation (HKSTP)
items.summary: Co-hosted the summer intern segment of HKSTP's company-wide townhall in front of the whole company and 8 C-suite members, and represented the intern cohort to share our internship experience and takeaways.

items.title: HKSTP x CLP Sustainable Residential Living Conference 2026
items.summary: Hosted a half-day flagship conference for senior government, developer and industry guests, running every segment and coordinating the rundown with 2 event agencies.
items.imageAlt: Emceeing the CLP x HKSTP Sustainable Residential Living Conference

items.title: Leadership Exchange: CEO Sharing Session
items.summary: Shared my summer internship experience and my takeaways from the One Person Hackathon with HKSTP CEO Terry Wong, CTO Fanny Wong, and fellow students.

items.title: Three Minute Thesis (3MT) Talk - ETMC 2026
items.summary: Presented my research at the HKUST Education & Technology Mini Conference (ETMC) 2026 on how gamification shapes motivation in sustainability learning, in a three-minute talk with a single slide and no notes, followed by peer Q&A.

items.title: Innovation Pop-up, JA Company Programme
items.summary: Emceed the Innovation Pop-up for JA Hong Kong's Company Programme, hosting the programme end-to-end across 2 full event days.
items.imageAlt: Emceeing the HSBC x JA HK Innovation Pop-up

items.title: BNY Corporate ESG Workshop
items.host: Zester × BNY; Facilitated by JA Asia Pacific
items.summary: Ran a gamified SDG workshop built around the Zester card game for BNY employees.

items.title: JA Asia Pacific Company of the Year
items.summary: Presented the SDG Innovation League section of Zester's scripted team pitch, then took judges' Q&A. Won 1st place out of 81,000+ students from 13 APAC countries.

items.title: JA Hong Kong Company of the Year
items.summary: Pitched Zester to the judging panel and answered Q&A. Won Champion, plus the Best Offering, Most Popular Offering and Innovation awards, out of 77 companies.
items.imageAlt: Pitching Zester at the JA Hong Kong Company of the Year finals
